description: I am thrilled to tell you that the 2024 legislative session was my most successful session yet, including my sponsorship and passage of 13 bills and nearly $30 million in funding to directly support the district and Anne Arundel County. In addition to my legislation, I focused my efforts working on Maryland’s budget priorities through my membership on the Appropriations Committee, especially on critical issues facing Marylanders as Vice Chair of the Sub-Committee on Health and Social Services.
title: Results | Dana Jones for 30A
